slots.note: M.2 2280 PCIe 3.0; double-sided drives up to 8TB fit

ports.note: Type-C USB 4.0 with charging and video output
Third Type-C port; speed not stated (spec: Type C*3, USB4*2)
TF card slot, up to 300 MB/s

screen.note: Two panels: Fantasy Black has a slim-bezel 800P (1280x800) screen, 400 nits, the same panel as the NEXT; Crystal Purple has the no-bezel 1200P (1920x1200) screen of the AYANEO 2. Values in this row are the 800P base panel

controls.note: Geek controller. Body gyroscope only. Hall triggers, 7.5 mm travel. Custom buttons LC, RC, and =

cooling: Custom fan cooler; vendor states up to 32-35 W heat dissipation
notes: AYANEO lists the Geek with AMD 6800U or AMD 6600U. This row is the 6800U; the Ryzen 5 6600U option is ayaneo-geek-6600u. Retail start price $949 (16GB/512GB); Super Early Bird $799 on Indiegogo. Launched with the AYANEO 2 on the same Indiegogo campaign; release month is the December 2022 shipping start reported for both models. Only the 512GB capacity is confirmed for the base price.
